proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12598 gives Pali suṇāti, Prakrit suṇaï, Hindi sunnā, Marwari suṇṇo and Awadhi sunab. Selected forms and pairs contain the same listening stem with ordinary inflections; sun-li- and auxiliary-bearing responses are excluded.
